what: AG-02 experiment: JEEVES_REQUIRE_TLS=true does not refuse NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0, and that variable turns off certificate verification for the generated runtime's fetch-based clients (externalTarget, identityTarget, httpTarget, the sign-in key set) while pg and Valkey keep verifying (their explicit rejectUnauthorized: true wins).
setup: One-off containers of the production image qrwtya-q04-app on the internal network qrwtya-q04-rehearsal: an HTTPS server with a certificate from the local test CA (not in Node's roots) and the stack's verified-TLS PostgreSQL reached with an unrelated CA (wrong-ca).
generatedOnlyR01: records/r01-matrix-generated.jsonl, setting node-tls-reject-off: session-api, link-api, account-api and billing-api start and become ready with it set under JEEVES_REQUIRE_TLS=true.
